metadata.title: Milkmaid Pitchers
metadata.description: An apparently unbounded navigable field of Milkmaid Pitchers models emerging through fog.
metadata.tileDescription: Explore an apparently unbounded field of Milkmaid Pitchers models.
metadata.archiveDescription: Portable archival specification for a navigable field of 199 selected Milkmaid Pitchers. The manifest contains the complete scene recipe, object membership, creator-provided item metadata, thumbnail and model CIDs, provenance, and rights. The records were selected from a larger public object listing; unselected source objects are not members of this scene.

historicalContext.note: No supported historical or exhibition context was supplied with the source inventory.

authorship.note: The creator states that the underlying 3D sculpture is their original work and that the Milkmaid Pitchers models were generated from it by an application they made. The application code was written before the AI boom. Blender, Three.js, and WebXR were used as open-source tools; they are tools, not sources of the artwork.

provenance.sourceDescription: The 199 pitcher records in this exhibit were selected from the public milkmaid-pitchers object collection. The creator states that the models were generated by their own application from their original 3D sculpture. The manifest directly indexes the complete selected scene set and its metadata.

sourceInventory.selectionNote: Complete scene membership; other source objects are intentionally excluded.

rights.licenseScope: Creator-authored artwork, generated models, metadata, prompts, and archive descriptions in this project.
rights.notes: The creator states that they made the underlying 3D sculpture and developed the application that generated these models from it, and licenses the creator-authored artwork, generated models, metadata, prompts, and archive descriptions under CC BY 4.0. Credit: Jarek Solecki. Blender, Three.js, and WebXR were used as open-source software tools; this license statement does not relicense those tools or other third-party materials.

items.label: About
items.content:
Milkmaid’s Pitcher — Generative Collection

More than 200 unique digital sculptures generated through interactions with Milkmaid’s Pitcher. Each object records a moment in a distributed performative process: a user’s gesture is translated through generative code into a new sculptural form, accompanied by metadata and geolocation. Emerging between human action, algorithm and data, the collection transforms a single virtual pitcher into an evolving archive of digitally born objects.

canonical: Visitors navigate a human-scale sculptural field with no perceptually meaningful architectural boundary.
The floor is a continuous horizontal ground reference at floorY; it is collision-bearing and visible as configured.
The 199 listed pitcher identities are the complete source pool for this scene; repeated content remains distinct by object identity.
A visitor-centered exclusion area prevents initial or replacement placements from obstructing the visitor.
Visible nearby sculptures remain spatially stable and can be selected to inspect their linked image and metadata.
Fog and background conceal the finite active simulation extent; models emerge gradually through fog.
Distant model instances may be reused only outside the configured recycling radius, beyond the fog visibility envelope, without visible discontinuity.
Initial spacing uses each model’s declared placement-radius proxy and scale; runtime visibility and recycling use transformed source-geometry bounds.

recommendedParameters.note: The creator supplied a browser image of this scene on 2026-10-06. It establishes the rendered baseline, including its dark fog, visible floor, cyan source materials, and model forms. The config preserves that observed behavior; the image shows that some source meshes are fragmented.

implementationFreedoms: A renderer may choose spatial indexing, batching, instancing, or streaming if distribution and perceptual behavior remain equivalent.
Another deterministic PRNG is acceptable if it preserves fixed-seed repeatability and equivalent spatial statistics.
Collision geometry may be simpler than render geometry if visitor movement and clearances remain equivalent.
nonGoals: Do not add enclosing walls, a horizon landmark, or a finite endpoint.
Do not replace sculptures with generated substitutes or merge duplicate-content identities.
Do not make visible models drift, sway, or change position in the perceptual region. A slow in-place yaw rotation is allowed by orientation.visibleYawRadiansPerSecond.
Do not require a particular software framework, rendering library, or this repository.

infiniteWorld.seedSemantics: Mulberry32 unsigned 32-bit generator. For each draw: state = (state + 0x6D2B79F5) mod 2^32; t = state; t = low32((t XOR unsignedShiftRight(t, 15)) * (t OR 1)); m = low32((t XOR unsignedShiftRight(t, 7)) * (t OR 61)); t = low32(t XOR low32(t + m)); return low32(t XOR unsignedShiftRight(t, 14)) / 2^32. Initial placement state is seed; replacement state is seed XOR recycling.randomStreamSeedXor. Visit models in manifest order. For each candidate, draw density first and reject immediately if the value exceeds density; otherwise draw scale, angle uniformly in [0, 2π), and area-uniform annulus radius sqrt(inner² + u*(outer²-inner²)). Reject if horizontal center distance to any accepted model is less than minSpacing plus both manifest-declared placement-radius proxies after scale. Draw yaw only after spacing passes. Accepted entries use floor.height, fixed pitch/roll, and drawn yaw. Total attempts are max(modelCount*candidateBudgetPerModel, minimumCandidateAttempts). Exhaustion before all models are placed is an error. Replacement draws: forward-bias selection, angular offset, destination radial offset; add replacementYawIncrementRadians after relocation.

fog.visibilityRule: A model is render-visible only when its nearest bounding-sphere surface is at or inside fog.end; fog attenuates from fog.start to fog.end.

placementRegion.measure: Horizontal center-radius bounds; each inner and outer limit is adjusted by the model’s manifest-declared placement-radius proxy times its sampled uniform scale.

distribution.densityMeaning: Acceptance probability during seeded candidate sampling; not an exact models-per-area promise.
distribution.minSpacingMeaning: Minimum horizontal clear gap between the declared placement-radius proxy spheres after each proxy is multiplied by its sampled instance scale. This placement proxy is 0.7 m for each listed model; runtime visibility and recycling use the transformed source-geometry bounds.
distribution.candidateBudgetMeaning: Total candidate attempts are max(modelCount * candidateBudgetPerModel, minimumCandidateAttempts). Process entries in manifest order and stop when all are placed. Failure to place every model within the budget is a reconstruction error.

scale.sourceModelSize: Preserve the referenced model geometry at its recorded source size; do not normalize its bounds. Center its transformed horizontal bounds and ground its lowest transformed point before applying the per-instance uniform scale.

grounding.rule: Translate the source model so its horizontal bounds center on the placement point and its lowest transformed bound rests at floor.height before applying placement scale and orientation.

activePopulation.sourcePool: the 199 listed pitcher identities in manifest order

recycling.trigger: nearest bounding-sphere surface distance exceeds recycleRadius
recycling.destination: Choose a seeded point in the forward angular interval. Its center radius is uniformly sampled from max(visitor.clearRadius, fog.end) + measured model radius + hiddenSafetyMarginMeters through the smaller of that radius plus destinationSearchDepthMeters or recycling.radius minus measured model radius and hiddenSafetyMarginMeters. If those radial bounds overlap, use the lower bound.
recycling.stability: Do not reposition an instance while its nearest transformed source-geometry bounding-sphere surface is within recycling.radius; this places replacements outside both the full fog envelope and the recycling boundary.
recycling.replacementYaw: add replacementYawIncrementRadians to the existing yaw
recycling.selection: Among instances whose nearest transformed source-geometry bounding-sphere surface is beyond recycling.radius, recycle the farthest-behind instance when one is behind the visitor; otherwise recycle the instance with the greatest surface distance.
recycling.randomStreamSemantics: For each replacement: draw once for forward-bias probability; draw once for the uniform angular offset within the configured half-angle when biased (otherwise across the full circle); draw once for the uniform destination radial offset. Add replacementYawIncrementRadians after relocation.

passive_sculpture.description: A preserved source GLB displayed as one distinct sculptural object identity in the field. The GLB geometry and material assignments define its appearance.

interaction.inspection: Open the linked thumbnail and metadata record.

preserved_nonrenderable_source.description: A preserved source GLB identity whose current geometry audit reports no usable visible mesh. Keep it in the archive inventory; do not invent replacement geometry.

camera.pose: visitor spawn position and eye height; orientation follows spawnDirection and visitor look input

presentation.qualityAdaptation: An implementation may reduce antialiasing, shadow detail, or pixel density for device capability while preserving scene composition and lighting intent.

interactions.description: Walk continuously through the field while supported by the configured ground surface.
Look around the field independently of walking; turning does not regenerate or reshuffle nearby objects.
Observe each renderable pitcher rotate slowly in place while visible. Rotation pauses when the object is outside the visibility envelope.
Reuse loaded distant objects only after fog hides them, placing replacements within the forward half-space so movement reveals a continuing field.

behavior.trigger: nearest bounding-sphere surface distance exceeds recycleRadius
behavior.destination: Choose a seeded point in the forward angular interval. Its center radius is uniformly sampled from max(visitor.clearRadius, fog.end) + measured model radius + hiddenSafetyMarginMeters through the smaller of that radius plus destinationSearchDepthMeters or recycling.radius minus measured model radius and hiddenSafetyMarginMeters. If those radial bounds overlap, use the lower bound.
behavior.selection: Among instances whose nearest transformed source-geometry bounding-sphere surface is beyond recycling.radius, recycle the farthest-behind instance when one is behind the visitor; otherwise recycle the instance with the greatest surface distance.

interactions.description: Where an immersive head-tracked view is available, let the visitor enter or exit it while preserving the same world, object pool, spawn, and scene state.
Select a pitcher to view its linked thumbnail, description, attribution, and recorded attributes.

viewerBrief.purpose: Preserve and reconstruct an apparently unbounded navigable field of Milkmaid Pitchers models.
viewerBrief.audience: Future archivists, researchers, and developers reconstructing from this manifest and its referenced assets.
requiredCapabilities: Load all 199 declared source model identities through the declared asset references; do not discover additional objects outside this manifest.
Preserve each original object key as a distinct identity, including matching-content duplicates.
Load and retain successful model assets for the exhibition session; a single failed or non-renderable asset must not prevent the field from running.
Preserve each source model’s recorded size, center and ground it, then apply the declared per-instance scale range.
Place the complete model list deterministically from the declared seed using the configured annular region, density, minimum surface spacing, and per-instance scale range.
Keep the local field spatially stable when the visitor moves or turns; do not regenerate nearby placements from visitor position.
Support keyboard walking, first-person looking, touch movement, and immersive head/controller input where available.
Constrain normal locomotion to the configured collision-bearing ground plane while leaving pitcher meshes non-blocking.
Apply configured slow in-place yaw animation only to renderable objects inside the fog visibility envelope.
Use linear fog and matching background to hide the active simulation boundary; recycle only fully hidden distant instances and never refetch them during recycling.
Keep the scene framework-independent: every interaction contract and visual/world parameter must be interpretable without repository-specific code or component behavior.
viewerBrief.visualTone: Sculptural forms emerge gradually from quiet dark fog; preserve their forms and spatial rhythm without decorative reinterpretation.
reconstructionPriorities: Preserve each referenced source model at its recorded source size; recenter and ground transformed geometry, then apply the declared per-instance scale.
Use the manifest-declared 0.7 m placement-radius proxy for seeded placement and spacing; use transformed source bounds for runtime visibility and recycling.
Preserve spawn, scale, spacing, fog envelope, and apparent unboundedness.
Keep nearby objects stable and recycling imperceptible.
Prefer perceptual and spatial equivalence over implementation similarity.
nonGoals: Do not infer authorship, licensing, dates, or historical context.
Do not merge assets with matching checksums.
Do not require repository-specific code, components, or services.
Do not invent mesh geometry for source models whose recorded geometry is degenerate or absent.
viewerBrief.reconstructionPrompt: Using only this manifest and its referenced archival assets, reconstruct the observed Milkmaid Pitchers field as a framework-independent, first-person 3D experience. Treat the structured scene configuration, all 199 model records, object profiles, and interaction contracts as authoritative. Implement the configured spawn, camera and look controls, movement, ground plane, deterministic seeded distribution and attempt budget, source-size-preserving recentering and grounding, placement-radius proxy, per-instance scale and spacing, visible-only yaw, fog and matching background, fixed and visitor-following lights, display color response, and hidden-only instance recycling. Keep nearby placements stable. Keep successful source assets resident; failures must not stop other items. Do not invent geometry for empty or fragmented source files. Preserve duplicate-content identities. Do not add enclosing architecture, grabbing, unconfigured interactions, or dependencies on any specific framework or repository.

prompts.sceneReconstruction: Treat this manifest as the complete scene specification and its referenced CIDs as the authoritative assets. Reconstruct the 199 listed identities in manifest order with the declared coordinate system, visitor spawn and movement, perspective camera, visitor-following light, visible floor, matching background and linear fog, source-material preservation, exact seeded placement procedure and candidate budget, declared placement-radius proxies, source-size-preserving grounding, per-instance scale and yaw, lighting and display values, and hidden-only recycling. Preserve local placements as the visitor moves or turns. Keep loaded assets resident and do not invent substitute geometry. Use equivalent implementations while preserving these values and behaviors; do not require current frameworks or tools.
prompts.objectInterpretation: Use each model entry and its linked item metadata record as the archival item record. Render only its referenced model. Preserve all recorded metadata without inventing historical meaning.
prompts.interactionImplementation: Implement each top-level interaction as a portable behavior contract. Map equivalent platform inputs to the declared actions in another framework; preserve outcomes, thresholds, units, and lifecycle semantics rather than copying repository-specific component names.
prompts.validation: Verify all 199 model references and their media records resolve from this manifest; confirm selected CIDs are retrievable; rerun the declared seeded placement and compare ordered model positions; check spawn clearance, placement gaps, source-size preservation, grounding, camera values, floor/background/fog colors, fixed and visitor-following lighting, display response, and visible-only yaw; walk and turn to confirm local stability; confirm recycling occurs only beyond the configured hidden boundary and makes no new asset request; and confirm a failed/empty model does not stop the other 198.

preservation.futureProofDefinition: The manifest is the sole scene authority: it contains the full 199-object index, model and thumbnail CIDs, item metadata, source bounds, spatial semantics, provenance, rights, and technology-neutral reconstruction intent.

integrity.note: SHA-256 values were computed from downloaded source bytes after matching every indexed byte size and Oracle-reported MD5.

geometryAudit.scope: The 199 scene model assets listed in this manifest.

ipfs.status: scene-manifest-not-yet-published; model and thumbnail CIDs are recorded per asset

requiredBeforeMinting: Verify retrieval of all 199 model and 199 thumbnail CIDs; record byte checksums and durable pinning or preservation locations.
Publish this complete manifest as an immutable snapshot and record its final CID and preservation receipt.
Confirm the chosen NFT token metadata exposes standard display fields while retaining this manifest CID as the reconstruction authority.
knownLimitations: The Oracle Object Storage source is a mutable delivery location; IPFS CIDs remain the canonical asset identities.
The browser rendered the scene on 2026-10-06, but the captured session also showed IPFS gateway HTTP 429 and CORS errors. Remote delivery remains intermittent.
Some visible models appear fragmented in the captured scene; the geometry audit checks bounds, not visual quality or mesh integrity.
One of the 199 selected model files has degenerate zero-size geometry. The other 12 objects in the broader source inventory are excluded from this scene.
The scene manifest itself has not yet been published as an immutable NFT or preservation snapshot.
